tinySoundFont.reuse: tsf.h copied unchanged to native/tsf.h; native/synth.c wraps it.

build: midi-synth.wasm: emcc -O2 --no-entry -sSTANDALONE_WASM=1 -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -sINITIAL_MEMORY=16777216 -sFILESYSTEM=0; fm-synth.wasm: the same with -msimd128, -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti and libADLMIDI's sequencer and other chips disabled (scripts/rebuild-wasm.sh)

libADLMIDI.reuse: native/adlmidi: the real-time synthesizer, the embedded banks and the WOPL reader, without the sequencer and the other chips; changes listed in native/ARCH.md.

nukedFast.reuse: native/adlmidi/src/chips/nuked_fast, unchanged but for a configuration guard and the included block renderer.

defussShadcn.reuse: Demo page only: runtime and component stylesheets copied to docs/shadcn by scripts/build.mjs.

bergium.reuse: Demo page only: packages/bergium/src copied unchanged to vendor/bergium/src, bundled by scripts/build.mjs from demo/visualizer.ts.

butterchurnPresets.reuse: Demo page only: the 14 presets of demo/bergium-presets.json, taken from lib/butterchurnPresets.min.js into docs/visualizer/presets.json by scripts/build.mjs.

defussBrotli.reuse: The slim decoder bundled into dist/ by pkgroll; dist/assets/brotli-decompressor.wasm is its decompressor.wasm.
